associations.rationale: This only defines the integer-valued content function and does not state how transpositions act on a Specht module.
This only constructs the sum-of-transpositions algebra element, a prerequisite for the action claim.
Centrality of the sum of transpositions supports a scalar-action argument but does not identify the scalar as diagram content on each Specht module.
The formal type directly says that multiplying any element of a Specht module by the sum of transpositions equals scalar multiplication by the partition content.
This gives the content-scalar identity only on the Young symmetrizer, so it is a generator-level helper rather than the full Specht-module action claim.
